snippet.title: Megabat // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429230/Megabat/

While in search of food, a fruit bat stumbles its way through the ventilation system of a secret facility finding unique fruit that give special abilities. While in search of more fruit the bat must avoid traps and enemies. Will the bat be able to satiate it's hunger and escape with its life?

Developed by 
Arff Studios
